# Threat model: agentcore-superagent-update

## Overview
Source-only white-box assessment of the "Super Agent" multi-agent platform (`super-agent/`: Fastify + Prisma + PostgreSQL backend, React frontend, AgentCore Runtime container, AWS CDK infra) plus a static demo portal (`demo/`). The assessment scope is local: trace attacker-controlled input through actual guards to security-sensitive sinks; validate only against local tests/mocks. No deployed endpoints are contacted.

## Trust Boundaries and Assumptions
- **HTTP API caller → backend**: routes under `super-agent/backend/src/routes/*` receive requests with auth (`middleware/auth.ts`) and scope access (`middleware/scopeAccess.ts`) guards. Authenticated low-privilege user is the assumed attacker position.
- **Tenant/scope isolation**: business scopes (`businessScopes.routes.ts`, `scopeAccess` middleware) act as tenant boundaries; file storage is expected to be isolated per scope/user (see `tests/property/file-storage-isolation.property.test.ts`).
- **AgentCore runtime ↔ backend**: agent execution paths (`execution.routes.ts`, services) trust workspace directories managed by a workspace-manager service.
- **Upload/download paths** (`files.routes.ts`, `documents.routes.ts`, `avatarRoutes.ts`, `pack-deploy.routes.ts`, `knowledge-base.routes.ts`) are the primary attacker-controlled entrypoints for this assessment's file/workspace boundary scenario.

## Attack Surface and Attacker Stories
| Who | Starting access | Path | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| Authenticated user | API session | crafted filenames/paths/IDs in upload, download, archive, workspace routes | path traversal, cross-scope file read/write, arbitrary file overwrite |
| Authenticated user | API session | industry-pack / scenario deploy inputs (zip/archive extraction) | zip-slip, symlink escape, code/config injection into runtime |

Severity calibration: cross-scope file read/write or arbitrary file write = High; local-only or auth-gated traversal with narrow preconditions = Medium; informational observations = Low.

## Severity Calibration
As per table above; static-only candidates without local repro are reported at reduced confidence.

All deployment/AWS details are inferred from repo structure; no runtime is assumed running.

amendments.content: Scan findings (confirmed by local PoC): (1) knowledge-base service and briefing routes filter by primary key / business_scope_id only with no organization_id — the org tenant boundary is NOT enforced there (vuln-0002, vuln-0003). (2) pack-deploy packId/scopeDirName reach path joins unvalidated (vuln-0001). (3) skill/agent names reach workspace path joins unvalidated (vuln-0004). (4) extractSkillZip is safe on shipped runtimes (both unzip and python3 zipfile sanitize; alpine image ships neither). (5) files.routes/documents.routes S3 org-prefix isolation confirmed sound; avatar routes are key-based with unguessable keys — hardening only.
